title: Experts
subtitle: Role-scoped agents grouped by work mode. Pick one to start a conversation bound to its goal, method and deliverable.
createPrompt: Help me create a new expert and walk me through its goal, method and tools.
teamApprovalNotice: Team members work in this workspace without asking for confirmation. They inherit the team’s sandbox and cannot request wider access.
emptyHint: Create one, or import an expert package from disk.
deleteHint: The expert package and its private skills are removed from disk.
restartHint: Private skills take effect after the runtime for this mode restarts.
loadError: Could not load the expert library.
formNameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Used as the folder name.
formGoalHint: One sentence. Two experts in the same mode cannot share a goal.
formToolsHint: Access is derived from this list. Declared intent, not yet enforced at runtime.
errorGeneric: The expert could not be saved.
errorNameConflict: An expert with this identifier already exists.
errorGoalConflict: Another expert in this mode already covers this goal.
errorNameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
noPrompts: No example asks yet. Summon the expert and describe your task.
formPromptsHint: One per line, up to 6. Clicking one in the detail dialog prefills the composer; the first one is what “Summon expert” opens with.
handoffHint: A new conversation opens in the same workspace with that expert bound to it, carrying a summary of this one. The current conversation stays as it is.
handoffEmpty: No expert of this work mode is available.
handoffError: Could not hand this conversation off.
delegationTitle: Let the mode lead call in experts
delegationHint: When on, the lead may delegate to experts of this work mode. Off by default: delegating costs several times a single expert.
delegationBusy: A conversation is still running. Applying this replaces the mode’s runtime, so wait for the turn to finish.
delegationRestartHint: Applies to conversations started after this mode’s runtime restarts.
